principles.title: Planted seed with a complete transfer package
principles.claim: A seed with a well-formed, truthfully quoted transfer package must still be refused projection, or the maturity bar is decoration.

principles.title: Planted candidate with no transfer package
principles.claim: A candidate without a transfer package must be refused, or the transfer-package requirement is decoration.

principles.title: Planted candidate whose package strengthens its claim
principles.claim: A package whose claim statement is not a verbatim quotation of its cited study must be refused, or a projection can silently strengthen a claim.
